# x509-limbo expected failures (test ids), one per line. Regenerated by

# Corpus: C2SP/x509-limbo @ 1187213 (2026-09-14), pinned in generate.sh.
#
# 28 cases (21 from 2026-09-14, 7 added 2026-09-15 with the corpus bump):
#   rfc5280--nc--permitted-empty-sequence-excluded-nonempty,
#   rfc5280--nc--permitted-nonempty-excluded-empty-sequence (2): TO FIX in
#     sparkx509. GeneralSubtrees is SEQUENCE SIZE (1..MAX) (RFC 5280 4.2.1.10);
#     an empty permittedSubtrees or excludedSubtrees is malformed and we accept
#     it. Tagged pedantic-rfc5280 upstream, but a one-line reject in the
#     NameConstraints parser.
#   rfc9881--ml-dsa-44/65/87 (3): ML-DSA signatures and keys (RFC 9881), not
#     implemented; revisit with the post-quantum work.
#   webpki--san--public-suffix-multi-label-wildcard-san,
#   webpki--san--public-suffix-private-namespace-wildcard-san (2): same class as
#     public-suffix-wildcard-san below; both need the Public Suffix List.
#
# The 21 from 2026-09-14, all policy decisions rather than open bugs:
#   bettertls--pathbuilding--tc61..68 (8): Max_Pool_Size = 8 intermediates; these
#     paths need 9-35. A bounded pool is the design.
#   webpki--cn--* (9): CN-in-SAN is a CA/Browser Forum issuance rule, not a
#     validator rule; we validate the SAN the certificate carries.
#   cve--cve-2024-0567 (1): path-building cycle case, under triage.
#   pathlen--validation-ignores-pathlen-in-leaf (1): leaf pathLen policy, under triage.
#   rfc5280--ca-as-leaf (1): CA certificate used as a leaf, policy under triage.
#   webpki--san--public-suffix-wildcard-san (1): needs the Mozilla Public Suffix
#     List, which we do not ship.
